name: MSME Competitive (Lean) Scheme
summary: Subsidises the engagement of lean manufacturing consultants to help MSMEs reduce waste, cut costs and improve manufacturing competitiveness.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: Ministry of MSME subsidises consultancy charges for lean manufacturing implementation: 80% for micro, 60% for small, and 50% for medium enterprises, averaging around 70% of the consultant fee.

criteria.description: All MSMEs registered with the Udyam registration portal are eligible to participate.
criteria.source_quote: All MSMEs registered with the UDYAM registration portal (of the MoMSME) will be eligible to participate in MSME Competitive (Lean) Scheme and avail related benefits/incentives.

criteria.description: The applicant must be a manufacturing MSE, and typically applies as part of a mini-cluster of similar units guided by a lean manufacturing consultant, not individually.
criteria.source_quote: The scheme is open to all manufacturing MSEs. The units should be registered with the DIC (EM-II) or with any other agency (professional body, association, Government agency, department, etc.).

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Join or form a mini-cluster of 8-10 similar manufacturing units, coordinated by an empanelled Lean Manufacturing Consultant.
Sign an engagement letter with the consultant assigned to the mini-cluster.

windows.notes: Rolling enrolment into mini-clusters, coordinated by regional implementing agencies.

benefits.description: Subsidy on consultancy fees for lean manufacturing implementation.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Subsidy paid to the empanelled consultant on behalf of the MSME after milestone completion, not as direct cash to the applicant.
benefits.source_quote: Ministry of MSME will subsidize* 80% of Micro, 60% of Small, 50% of Medium Enterprises' Consultancy charges: average 70% of Fee
